/- Exact component: PolynomialDecider143d.lean -/
/-!
# A fixed finite native polynomial Boolean decider

Development source. This interface records an actual primitive-machine run,
with fixed finite carriers and supplied defaults before the input quantifier.
It does not define or assert equivalence with a conventional NP class.

The concrete controller retains a stronger complete singleton output theorem;
the reusable decision contract observes a nonblank Boolean letter at a real
stopped configuration. The outer-none observation is counted separately.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option warningAsError true
